Hilt Gradle plugin versions compiled against Kotlin 2.0+ ship .kotlin_module metadata in the Kotlin 2.0 format. Gradle's kotlin-dsl script compiler is locked to Kotlin 1.8 language/API level for the entire Gradle 8.x line and only moves to Kotlin 2.2 at Gradle 9.0.0. Loading a Kotlin 2.0+ plugin jar under Gradle 8.x throws InvalidProtocolBufferException during Kotlin-DSL script compilation.
edges.source: Gradle blog; hilt-android-gradle-plugin POM inspection; reproduced empirically on AGP 8.1.4 + Gradle 8.0 + Hilt 2.58 (combo e90703eb89081e0b)
